description: Use Raycast's Window Layout feature to create a named layout called 'Reading' that opens Safari pointed at https://news.ycombinator.com on the LEFT HALF of the screen and Notes on the RIGHT HALF of the screen. After creating the layout, trigger it once so the apps are launched and positioned. Do not drag windows manually with the mouse — use Raycast's Create Window Layout command (Raycast > Window Management) so the layout is reusable. Result: Safari front tab shows news.ycombinator.com on the left half, Notes is open on the right half.
